mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies and 53 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail. The air quality index is at a moderate 58, and we have a full moon gracing the sky tonight.

Regarding city news, the Finance Department is currently handling the proposed 2027 budget. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to meet on November 4th to review various site plans and plats, including developments on Jenna Drive and Milky Way.

There is plenty to do around town. Today you can catch the Dane County Farmers Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can check out yoga at Insight Wellness on October 26 or trivia at the Hop Haus on October 27.

On October 15, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of a school bus driver operating while impaired. Officers arrested the driver and are currently reviewing the incident, though fortunately, no injuries were reported.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor of the day is Turtle. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
